title: Voltztekk Reborn
description: A Re-imagining of Voltz-Tekk which was a modification of the Cult Classic: Voltz
body:
**A Re-imagining of Voltz-Tekk which was a modification of the Cult Classic: Voltz**

Over 200 mods of Tech, Farming, Cooking, Furnishings and Exploration, theres a little bit of something for almost everyone... did I mention we have missiles?

_Due to the nature of the Mod Pack - Minimum Required Ram: 5GB - Recommended Ram: 8GB_


Please raise any suggestions on the issues page

_Due to some previously included magic mods not being up-to-date with the rest of the pack, and the general size of the pack, the decision was made to cull magic from the pack, the World of Voltztekk lost a little wonder_

Server Pack available on request
